title: pi-subagent v2 configuration
description: One asynchronous agent tree. Old scheduling and mailbox-protocol settings are not supported.

agentScope.description: Definition catalog scope. Project definitions require project trust.

maxDepth.description: Absolute delegation depth. Root is depth zero.

maxConcurrentAgents.description: Maximum active child runs across the entire root tree. Admission fails immediately at capacity; root does not count.

inheritExtensions.description: Load other Pi extensions in children, subject to project trust and tool ceilings. pi-subagent itself is excluded.

openAIIdentity.description: Inject the optional Codex identity lifecycle in OpenAI Responses and virtual children.

maxOutputBytes.description: Maximum completion body size in UTF-8 bytes, additionally bounded to 128 KiB for mailbox delivery. Full output stays in the child session.
